meta.title: Chonky frame-rate mode
meta.description: Four Chonky tiers: Normal dive 60Hz, Soft & squishy 90Hz, Bubble dash 120Hz, Full-speed tail whip 144Hz. The chosen tier is locked at or above that rate, and the page shows the lock state plus your measured screen refresh rate; if the screen cannot reach the tier it says "Not locked" instead of pretending. Restart the engine after installing. This frame-rate mode is for DSH only.
